summary: Layer 1B expansion for the AI optical photonics component node identifies two reference leaders with direct InP/800G/1.6T exposure, one high-purity contract manufacturing/platform exposure, and one smaller speculative platform attempting to route around native InP substrate constraints. The cleanest direct-exposure names are Coherent and Lumentum, but both are now large-cap/high-attention reference anchors. Fabrinet is a second-order but direct manufacturing beneficiary tied to optical communications/datacom volume. Aeluma is the underfollowed small-cap/speculative-shadow candidate because its III-V-on-large-diameter-silicon approach could matter if InP wafer/device capacity remains constrained, but commercial datacenter qualification evidence still needs verification.
